start.title: النفَس الأول
start.text:
تفتح عينيك في حديقة دافئة.
صوت داخلي يهمس: أنت محبوب.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Peace settles deep in your chest.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run off to test your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The garden answers only with silence.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Demand to know who made you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The voice does not answer demands.

naming.title: تسمية المخلوقات
naming.text:
تتجمع الحيوانات، تنتظر.
يطلب منك الرب أن تسمي كل واحد منها.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Each name fits as if it were always theirs.
[TODO:ar] They wait, patient and confused.

lonely.title: وحيدًا بين الأزواج
lonely.text:
لكل مخلوق رفيقه.
أنت وحدك من تقف وحيدًا.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You breathe, and let the ache become prayer.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Search the wild on your own
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You walk far. Nothing fills the silence.
[TODO:ar] Bitterness only deepens the loneliness.

deep_sleep.title: نوم عميق
deep_sleep.text:
سلام عظيم يغشاك.
تغمض عيناك، والرب يعمل.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You let go. Something new begins.
[TODO:ar] You cannot resist His hand. Sleep comes anyway.

meet_eve.title: عظم من عظمي
meet_eve.text:
تستيقظ — وهي هناك.
امرأة، خُلقت لك، مساوية لك.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "This at last is bone of my bone."
[TODO:ar] She lowers her eyes. The garden grows quieter.
[TODO:ar] She follows, unsure why you turn away.

warning.title: الشجرة المحرمة
warning.text:
يريك الله شجرة واحدة مميزة.
"لا تأكلا منها، وإلا ستموتان."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Peace returns. The garden feels safe.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wonder why He hides it from you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A seed of suspicion takes root.
[TODO:ar] The thought lingers, sweet and dangerous.

serpent.title: سؤال الحية
serpent.text:
تتحدث حية إلى حواء:
"هل قال الله حقًا ألا تأكلا؟"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand beside her — repeat God's word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You speak the truth aloud. The serpent hisses.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stay silent and let her answer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Her voice trembles. You say nothing.
[TODO:ar] The whisper begins to feel reasonable.

fruit.title: الثمرة في يدها
fruit.text:
أخذت حواء الثمرة. تعرضها عليك.
عيناها تتوسلان — وتحترقان.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your hand drops to your side. But she has already eaten.
[TODO:ar] Sweet. Then bitter. Then — you know.
[TODO:ar] Love twists into disobedience. You bite.

shame.title: عيون مفتوحة
shame.text:
تريان أنفسكما — عاريين، خائفين.
أوراق التين لا تستطيع أن تغطي ما تغير.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Shame becomes sorrow. Sorrow opens a door.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run and hide in the trees
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You crouch in the brush. His voice still finds you.
[TODO:ar] The anger feels safe. It is not.

confrontation.title: «أين أنت؟»
confrontation.text:
يمشي الرب في الجنة وينادي.
صوته ليس غاضبًا — بل حزين.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Truth is heavy. And it sets something free.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "The woman You gave me did it"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You point. The blame does not save you.
[TODO:ar] Silence cannot hide a fallen heart.

expulsion.title: شرق عدن
expulsion.text:
يكسوكما، ثم يفتح البوابة.
تأخذ يدها. تمشيان شرقًا، إلى العالم.
